page.overview:
Who is Lucifer?

Luci Jenifer Inacio Das Neves, who goes by by the name of Lucifer, is a character created by American comic book creator Michael Alan Nelson for the Gray Man story arc of his Mythos series Fall of Cthulhu. She made her first appearance in issue #11 in March 2008.

A pretty young woman in her late teens or early twenties, Lucifer lived her early life as an orphan thief on the streets of Brazil. There, she encountered an occultist named Walter McKinley who took her in, making use of her talents as a thief in exchange for food and board. Under his tutelage, she gained a degree of mystical knowledge, including how to use protective wards and travel to the Dreamlands.

As an adult, Lucifer continues to use her talents to combat the supernatural threats which threaten humanity, despite the recent loss of her mentor.

Lucifer has, during the course of her activities, stolen a precious artefact from the supernatural creature known as the Harlot. Although she has been punished for this transgression, she remains in the Harlot's debt.
